cards.name: InsertionPoint
cards.path: Text processing commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/InsertionPoint
cards.summary: A zero-width position between two characters of a text story; a script uses it as the spot where new text goes, by adding characters at that point. It holds no text and no formatting of its own, only read-only links to the story and the text around it.
use_for: insert a word or symbol at a fixed position in an existing headline without retyping the frame
prepend or append copy (price, unit, trademark sign) to text frames in a template batch
add text at the start or end of one paragraph or word through that range's own insertionPoints
avoid: styling text: an insertion point has no character or paragraph attributes; style the TextRange returned by characters.add, or use TextRange.paragraphAttributes
replacing whole contents: set TextFrameItem.contents or TextRange.contents instead of inserting piece by piece
cards.how: Represents one caret position in Illustrator text. Reached through the insertionPoints collection of a TextFrameItem, TextRange or Story (e.g. app.activeDocument.textFrames[0].insertionPoints[0]); the collection is an InsertionPoints object (length, getByName). All harvested members are read-only: parent and typename, story (the whole threaded story) and the characters / words / lines / paragraphs / textRanges collections at that position. New text is inserted with insertionPoint.characters.add("..."), which returns a TextRange you can then format.

key_members.name: characters
key_members.use: the Characters collection at this point; characters.add(contents) inserts text here and returns the new TextRange

key_members.name: story
key_members.use: the Story the point lives in (spans all threaded frames); use it to reach story.insertionPoints for whole-story positions

key_members.name: paragraphs
key_members.use: paragraph collection at this position, e.g. to read the paragraph the caret sits in

key_members.name: words
key_members.use: word collection at this position

key_members.name: lines
key_members.use: line collection at this position (depends on current composition / frame width)

key_members.name: textRanges
key_members.use: all text ranges at this position

key_members.name: parent
key_members.use: the object's container; the harvest types it only as Object, so which object comes back (frame, range or story) is not recorded

key_members.name: typename
key_members.use: returns "InsertionPoint"; check it before treating an object as a text range

gotchas: Every harvested member is read-only and there is no contents, length or characterAttributes on this class: you cannot write text into an insertion point directly, only through characters.add.
typename exists only in ExtendScript; the COM interface instead has Application (harvest diff omv_only / com_only).
Indexes shift after each insert: when inserting at several positions, work from the highest index down (unverified that Illustrator re-indexes live collections immediately).

A text of n characters has n + 1 insertion points (indexes 0 to n): the last one, after the final character, is insertionPoints[insertionPoints.length - 1], i.e. index = the text's character count (unverified).
insertionPoints taken from a TextFrameItem in a threaded story may cover only that frame; use story.insertionPoints to address the full story (unverified).
words / lines at a zero-width position may be empty or return the adjacent word / line; do not rely on them without testing (unverified).
cards.source: ai_api_06 agent (harvest omv + COM typelib, members checked against batch)

review.changes: parent key_member no longer claims a specific container type (harvest only says Object); n+1 gotcha rewritten so the last index is insertionPoints.length - 1 (old wording 'last valid index is length' read as an out-of-range index); replaced the weak 'find which story a cursor belongs to' use_for with a range-level insert job

cards.name: ParagraphAttributes
cards.path: Text processing commands and classes for Adobe Illustrator/ParagraphAttributes
cards.summary: The paragraph-formatting bundle of Illustrator text: alignment, indents, space before / after, hyphenation, justification spacing limits, auto-leading, tab stops, bullets / numbering list style, composer choice and the CJK and right-to-left options. It is what the Paragraph panel, its Justification and Hyphenation dialogs and the separate Tabs panel set, exposed to scripts.
use_for: centre or justify body copy in templated posters and flyers from a script
set first-line indent and space-after for multi-paragraph area text in brochures
turn hyphenation on or off and tune spacing for tight newspaper-style columns
switch composerEngine for Hindi / Devanagari or Arabic paragraphs so shaping and line breaks come out right (which enum value is the World-Ready composer is unverified, see gotchas)
apply a consistent paragraph look inside a paragraph style definition
avoid: setting line spacing in points: leading and autoLeading live on CharacterAttributes, not here (only autoLeadingAmount and leadingType are paragraph-level)
styling many frames the same way by hand: put the values in a ParagraphStyle (paragraphStyle.paragraphAttributes) and applyTo the text instead
cards.how: Not created directly: read it from a text object's paragraphAttributes property, e.g. app.activeDocument.textFrames[0].textRange.paragraphAttributes (all paragraphs of the frame), textFrame.paragraphs[i].paragraphAttributes (one paragraph) or paragraphStyle.paragraphAttributes (a style definition). Setting a property on a range writes a local override on every paragraph in that range. Lengths (indents, spaceBefore / spaceAfter) are in points; spacing and glyph-scaling values are percentages; hyphenationPreference runs 0 (better spacing) to 1 (fewer hyphens). COM exposes the same properties with initial capitals and Ai-prefixed enum types (AiJustification ...).

key_members.name: justification
key_members.use: alignment: Justification.LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT / FULLJUSTIFYLASTLINELEFT ... FULLJUSTIFY

key_members.name: firstLineIndent
key_members.use: first-line indent in points (negative for a hanging indent)

key_members.name: leftIndent
key_members.use: left indent in points

key_members.name: rightIndent
key_members.use: right indent in points

key_members.name: spaceBefore
key_members.use: space above the paragraph in points

key_members.name: spaceAfter
key_members.use: space below the paragraph in points

key_members.name: hyphenation
key_members.use: turn hyphenation on / off for the paragraph

key_members.name: hyphenationPreference
key_members.use: 0 = better spacing, 1 = fewer hyphens (harvested range 0 to 1)

key_members.name: hyphenateCapitalizedWords
key_members.use: allow hyphenating capitalised words (usually off for headlines and names)

key_members.name: desiredWordSpacing
key_members.use: target word spacing in percent

key_members.name: minimumWordSpacing
key_members.use: lower word-spacing limit for justified lines, percent

key_members.name: maximumWordSpacing
key_members.use: upper word-spacing limit for justified lines, percent

key_members.name: desiredLetterSpacing
key_members.use: target letter spacing in percent

key_members.name: desiredGlyphScaling
key_members.use: target glyph scaling in percent

key_members.name: autoLeadingAmount
key_members.use: auto-leading as a percentage of the font size

key_members.name: leadingType
key_members.use: AutoLeadingType.BOTTOMTOBOTTOM (Roman) or TOPTOTOP (Japanese)

key_members.name: tabStops
key_members.use: array of TabStopInfo (alignment, position, leader, decimalCharacter)

key_members.name: everyLineComposer
key_members.use: true = Every-line Composer, false = Single-line Composer

key_members.name: composerEngine
key_members.use: ComposerEngineType.latinCJKComposer / optycaComposer / adornment

key_members.name: listStyle
key_members.use: bullets / numbering ListStyle for the paragraph; listStyleTier sets its level

gotchas: Absolute leading is not here: use characterAttributes.leading / autoLeading; this class only holds autoLeadingAmount and leadingType.
Indents and paragraph spacing are always points, whatever the document ruler units are.

minimumWordSpacing / maximumWordSpacing (and the letter and glyph min / max pairs) only act on justified lines and must bracket the desired value; out-of-order values may be rejected or clamped (unverified).
Setting textRange.paragraphAttributes writes local overrides; paragraphStyle.applyTo(text, true) is the way to clear them back to the style.
Reading a property over a range whose paragraphs differ may give the first paragraph's value or undefined rather than a 'mixed' marker (unverified).
tabStops is an array of TabStopInfo: build the whole array and assign it; editing an element of the returned array in place may not stick (unverified).
Full-justify options matter only for area text or text on a path; point text has no frame width to justify to (unverified).

optycaComposer is believed to be the World-Ready composer needed for correct Devanagari / Arabic shaping (unverified mapping); bunriKinshi, burasagariType, kinsoku, kinsokuOrder, kurikaeshiMojiShori and mojikumi only affect Japanese composition, paragraphDirection and kashidaWidth only right-to-left text.
cards.source: ai_api_06 agent (harvest omv + COM typelib, members checked against batch)

review.changes: CDR equivalent class:StyleParagraph -> class:TextRange: the harvested IVGStyleParagraph has a single member (Style), so no paragraph setting is reachable on it, while IVGTextRange carries Alignment, FirstLineIndent, LeftIndent, RightIndent, ParaSpacingBefore/After, Min/MaxWordSpacing, AutoHyphenate, HyphenHotZone, Tabs; summary no longer calls Tabs a Paragraph-panel flyout dialog (it is its own panel); composer use_for now flags the unverified enum mapping
